mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 67 degrees at Fireman's Park with an air quality index of 77, which is in the moderate range today.

The City of Verona is hosting a Plan Commission meeting on November 4th to discuss several projects including the Ardent Glen Third Addition and site plans for Milky Way. Additionally, residents are reminded that property tax bills will be mailed by December 15th.

Today features live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, the Dane County Farmer's Market is tomorrow, followed by trivia nights starting Monday at the Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company.

The Verona Police Department released a report regarding an incident on Thursday October 15th, where officers arrested a school bus driver for O W I. Authorities confirmed that no students or bystanders were injured during the incident.
The flavor of the day is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. Culver's is currently open and serving until 10:30 PM tonight, so stop by and grab a scoop.
